posts.trend: India’s Business Activity Hits Four Month High in October, but Hiring Remains Flat
posts.context: Companies are driving record output by absorbing headcount loss into existing employees rather than hiring replacements.
posts.angle: Record business growth with zero hiring means you are doing three people's jobs for your 2021 salary.
slides: Your team size dropped by forty percent. The targets stayed.

Q1 — manage two projects.
Q2 — cover for the manager.
Q3 — onboard the intern.
Q4 — realize there is no intern.
The quarterly report calls this operational efficiency.
posts.caption: Somebody in your team is currently doing two resignations worth of work.
posts.rank_verdict: It functions as an accurate corporate complaint rather than a laugh-out-loud joke.
